package course

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
)

// ListCourses returns localized previews for courses.
type ListCourses struct {
	Courses repository.CourseRepository
}

// Handle fetches course previews using default version and locale.
func (uc ListCourses) Handle(ctx context.Context, lang string) ([]domain.CoursePreview, error) {
	return uc.Courses.List(ctx, lang, filters.CourseFilters{}, nil)
}

// HandleWithFields fetches course previews with specified fields only.
func (uc ListCourses) HandleWithFields(ctx context.Context, lang string, f queryfields.Set, filters filters.CourseFilters, sort *filters.SortOptions) ([]map[string]any, int, error) {
	return uc.Courses.ListFields(ctx, lang, f, filters, sort)
}
